blurb: You can find us just off highway 35, approximately 16 km north of Manning, AB. Our par 36, 9-hole golf course is a beauty with both challenging and forgiving holes! Oh, and we host the most popular tournaments in Northern Alberta! Services include: equipment/clothing sales and club rentals, power cart rentals, fully licensed restaurant/lounge/deck, and a campground with ample capacity.
